insight: Both Romans 12:2 and 1 Peter 1:14 command believers not to conform to former patterns associated with the sinful world, using the Greek verb συσχηματίζομαι (to be conformed or fashioned according to a pattern). Romans emphasizes ongoing resistance to the present evil age and the transformative renewal of the mind by God, enabling discernment of God's will. Similarly, Peter exhorts believers, as obedient children, to reject their former lustful desires that characterized their ignorance before salvation, highlighting the change in identity and character resulting from regeneration.
